title: Comparing Things
description: Membandingkan orang, tempat, dan produk dengan comparative, superlative, dan as ... as / not as ... as.
objectives: Membentuk comparative adjectives (-er / more) dengan ejaan yang benar
Menggunakan as ... as dan not as ... as
Membandingkan kota, produk, dan orang dengan kosakata yang tepat

lessons.title: Comparatives: -er than
lessons.summary: Membandingkan dua hal dengan adjective pendek + -er + than.
objectives: Membentuk comparative dari adjective satu suku kata dan adjective berakhiran -y
Menerapkan aturan ejaan: bigger, easier, nicer
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Membandingkan dua hal
Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita berkata *lebih besar daripada*. Dalam bahasa Inggris, untuk adjective pendek kita menambahkan **-er** dan memakai **than** (daripada):

*A bus is **bigger than** a car.* (Bus lebih besar daripada mobil.)

### Pola
**Subject + be + adjective-er + than + ...**

### Aturan ejaan
| Jenis adjective | Aturan | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 suku kata (umum) | + **-er** | tall → tall**er**, cheap → cheap**er**, fast → fast**er** |
| berakhiran **-e** | + **-r** | nice → nice**r**, large → large**r**, safe → safe**r** |
| 1 vokal + 1 konsonan | **gandakan** + -er | big → bi**gger**, hot → ho**tter**, thin → thi**nner** |
| 2 suku kata berakhiran **-y** | y → **-ier** | easy → eas**ier**, happy → happ**ier**, busy → bus**ier** |

Aturan menggandakan konsonan mirip dengan aturan *stop → stopped* di Unit 2. Tetapi jangan gandakan **w**: *new → newer*, *slow → slower*.

### Than, bukan that atau from
Kesalahan umum: ✗ *bigger that*, ✗ *bigger from*. Kata pembanding yang benar adalah **than** /ðæn/.

### Tanpa more
Untuk adjective pendek, **jangan** tambahkan *more*: ✗ *more bigger*, ✗ *more tall*. Akhiran *-er* sudah berarti *lebih*.

### Membandingkan di masa lalu
Karena kamu sudah belajar was/were, kamu juga bisa membandingkan di masa lalu: *The exam was **easier than** last year's exam.*

### Penekanan dengan much
Untuk mengatakan *jauh lebih*, tambahkan **much** sebelum comparative: *My new flat is **much bigger** than my old one.*

lessons.title: More Expensive, Better, Worse
lessons.summary: Comparative untuk adjective panjang (more + adjective) dan adjective tidak beraturan.
objectives: Membentuk comparative dengan more untuk adjective dua suku kata atau lebih
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Adjective panjang: more + adjective
Untuk adjective dengan **dua suku kata atau lebih** (kecuali yang berakhiran -y), kita **tidak** menambah -er. Kita memakai **more** di depannya:

| Adjective | Comparative |
| --- | --- |
| expensive | **more** expensive |
| comfortable | **more** comfortable |
| interesting | **more** interesting |
| beautiful | **more** beautiful |
| modern | **more** modern |
| famous | **more** famous |

*This hotel is **more comfortable than** the other one.*

### Ingat pengecualian -y
Adjective dua suku kata berakhiran **-y** tetap memakai **-ier**: *easy → easier*, *happy → happier*, *busy → busier*, *funny → funnier*.

### Adjective tidak beraturan
Tiga adjective ini harus dihafal:

| Adjective | Comparative | Arti |
| --- | --- | --- |
| good | **better** | lebih baik/bagus |
| bad | **worse** | lebih buruk |
| far | **farther / further** | lebih jauh |

✗ *gooder*, ✗ *more good*, ✗ *badder*.

### Jangan gabungkan more dan -er
Salah satu kesalahan paling umum: ✗ *more better*, ✗ *more cheaper*, ✗ *more quieter*. Pilih **salah satu**: -er **atau** more.

### Less (lebih sedikit/kurang)
Kebalikan dari *more* adalah **less**: *This phone is **less expensive** than that one.* (Ponsel ini kurang mahal / lebih murah daripada yang itu.) Bentuk ini lebih sering dipakai dengan adjective panjang.

### Ringkasan cara memilih
1. Satu suku kata? → **-er** (*cheaper*)
2. Dua suku kata berakhiran -y? → **-ier** (*easier*)
3. Dua suku kata atau lebih lainnya? → **more** (*more modern*)
4. good / bad / far? → **better / worse / further**

### Contoh dalam percakapan
*A: Which hotel is better, the Sunrise or the Palm?*
*B: The Palm is **more expensive**, but it's **more comfortable** and **further** from the noisy main road. I think it's **better** for a family holiday.*

Perhatikan bagaimana satu jawaban bisa memakai beberapa bentuk comparative sekaligus.

lessons.title: Superlatives: the Biggest, the Most Beautiful
lessons.summary: Menyatakan yang paling dengan the + -est atau the most.
objectives: Membentuk superlative dengan the -est, the most, the best, dan the worst
Memakai in dan of setelah superlative
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Superlative = paling
Comparative membandingkan **dua** hal. Superlative membandingkan **tiga atau lebih** hal dan menyatakan **yang paling**.

*Rafi is **the tallest** student in our class.* (Rafi adalah murid paling tinggi di kelas kami.)

### Pembentukan
| Jenis adjective | Comparative | Superlative |
| --- | --- | --- |
| pendek | cheap**er** | **the** cheap**est** |
| berakhiran -e | nice**r** | **the** nice**st** |
| vokal + konsonan | bi**gger** | **the** bi**ggest** |
| berakhiran -y | eas**ier** | **the** eas**iest** |
| panjang | **more** famous | **the most** famous |
| good | better | **the best** |
| bad | worse | **the worst** |
| far | further | **the furthest** |

Aturan ejaannya sama dengan comparative. Jadi jika kamu sudah menguasai *-er*, kamu juga bisa membuat *-est*.

### Jangan lupa the
Superlative hampir selalu memakai **the**: ✗ *She is best student.* ✓ *She is **the best** student.* Kata *the* juga bisa diganti dengan kata kepemilikan: *my best friend* (sahabat terbaikku).

### In atau of?
- **in** + tempat atau kelompok: *the biggest city **in** the country*, *the youngest **in** my family*
- **of** + periode waktu atau jumlah: *the best day **of** my life*, *the hottest month **of** the year*, *the cheapest **of** the three*

### Superlative di masa lalu
*It was **the worst** day of my holiday. I lost my bag and it rained all day.*

### Tips untuk penutur bahasa Indonesia
Kata *paling* dalam bahasa Indonesia selalu sama, tetapi dalam bahasa Inggris kamu harus memilih **-est** atau **most** berdasarkan panjang adjective. Jangan gabungkan keduanya: ✗ *the most biggest*.

lessons.title: As ... As and Not As ... As
lessons.summary: Menyatakan kesamaan dan perbedaan dengan as ... as dan not as ... as.
objectives: Menyatakan dua hal yang sama dengan as + adjective + as
Menyatakan perbedaan dengan not as + adjective + as
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### As ... as = sama ...-nya
Untuk mengatakan bahwa dua hal **sama**, gunakan **as + adjective (bentuk dasar) + as**:

*My sister is **as tall as** my mother.* (Kakak perempuanku **setinggi** ibuku.)

Bahasa Indonesia memakai awalan *se-* (*setinggi, sebesar, semahal*). Bahasa Inggris memakai **as ... as**.

### Not as ... as = tidak se...
Bentuk negatif menunjukkan bahwa hal pertama **kurang** daripada hal kedua:

*My phone **isn't as expensive as** your phone.* (Ponselku tidak semahal ponselmu.)

Artinya sama dengan: *Your phone is **more expensive than** my phone.* atau *My phone is **cheaper than** your phone.*

| Kalimat | Arti |
| --- | --- |
| A is **as** big **as** B. | A = B |
| A is**n't as** big **as** B. | A < B (B lebih besar) |
| A is bigg**er than** B. | A > B |

### Adjective tetap bentuk dasar
Di antara *as ... as*, adjective **tidak** berubah: ✗ *as bigger as*, ✗ *as more expensive as*. ✓ *as big as*, ✓ *as expensive as*.

### Jangan campur dengan than
✗ *as tall than*. Pasangan yang benar selalu **as ... as**, sedangkan *than* hanya untuk comparative (-er/more).

### Kapan memakai not as ... as?
*Not as ... as* sering terdengar **lebih sopan** daripada comparative langsung. Bandingkan:
- *Your cooking is worse than mine.* (terdengar kasar)
- *Your cooking isn't as good as mine.* (lebih halus)

### Di masa lalu
*The test **wasn't as difficult as** I expected.* (Ujiannya tidak sesulit yang saya kira.)
*The second film **was as good as** the first one.*

lessons.title: Comparing Cities, Products and People
lessons.summary: Kosakata adjective untuk orang, tempat, dan produk serta penggunaannya dalam perbandingan.
objectives: Menggunakan adjective untuk mendeskripsikan orang, tempat, dan produk
Membandingkan dua kota atau dua produk dengan semua bentuk perbandingan
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, coba latihan berbicara, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Adjective untuk tempat
| Adjective | Arti | Lawan kata |
| --- | --- | --- |
| crowded | padat, penuh sesak | empty |
| peaceful | damai, tenang | noisy |
| modern | modern | old-fashioned |
| polluted | tercemar | clean |
| safe | aman | dangerous |

### Adjective untuk orang
*friendly* (ramah), *generous* (murah hati), *hard-working* (rajin), *lazy* (malas), *patient* (sabar), *polite* (sopan).

### Adjective untuk produk
*reliable* (andal, tidak mudah rusak), *light* (ringan), *heavy* (berat), *useful* (berguna), *good value* (sepadan dengan harganya).

### Menggabungkan semua bentuk perbandingan
Saat membandingkan dua kota atau produk, variasikan struktur kalimatmu:

*Riverton is **bigger and more modern than** Sunny Bay, but it's **more polluted**. Sunny Bay **isn't as exciting as** Riverton, but it's **the most peaceful** town on the coast.*

| Struktur | Fungsi |
| --- | --- |
| comparative + than | membandingkan dua hal |
| superlative | yang paling di antara banyak hal |
| as ... as / not as ... as | sama / kurang |

### Memberi pendapat
Gunakan ungkapan berikut untuk memberi pendapat saat membandingkan:
- *In my opinion, ...* (Menurut saya, ...)
- *I think ... is better because ...*
- *For me, the most important thing is ...*

### Contoh: membandingkan dua laptop
*The Nova 14 is **lighter** and **cheaper** than the Orbit X. The Orbit X has a bigger screen, but its battery **isn't as good**. In my opinion, the Nova 14 is **better value** for students.*

### Tips
Jangan hanya memberi satu kalimat perbandingan. Berikan **alasan** dengan *because* dan **kontras** dengan *but*, seperti yang kamu pelajari di Unit 3.

questions.prompt: Choose the best word: There are too many people and cars in the city centre. It's very ___.
questions.explanation: Terlalu banyak orang dan mobil → crowded (padat).

questions.prompt: Compare your town with another town or city you know. Talk for 45–60 seconds. Use at least one comparative, one superlative, and one not as ... as sentence.
questions.sampleAnswer: I live in a small town near Malang. Malang is much bigger than my town, and it's more modern. There are more shops and cafés. But my town isn't as crowded as Malang, and the air is cleaner. The most beautiful place in my town is the rice field behind my house. In my opinion, my town is better for families because it's safer and more peaceful.
questions.explanation: Pakai comparative (bigger than), superlative (the most beautiful), not as ... as, lalu tutup dengan pendapat dan alasan.

questions.prompt: Match each adjective with its opposite.
questions.explanation: Lawan kata: peaceful–noisy, modern–old-fashioned, safe–dangerous, polluted–clean, hard-working–lazy.

questions.prompt: Read the information. Which sentence is true?
questions.context:
**Nova 14** — price: Rp 6,000,000 — weight: 1.2 kg — battery: 10 hours

**Orbit X** — price: Rp 8,000,000 — weight: 2 kg — battery: 6 hours
options: The Orbit X is lighter than the Nova 14.
The Nova 14 is cheaper and lighter than the Orbit X.
The Orbit X's battery is as good as the Nova 14's battery.
The Nova 14 is more expensive than the Orbit X.
questions.explanation: Nova 14 lebih murah (6 juta < 8 juta) dan lebih ringan (1,2 kg < 2 kg). Baterainya juga lebih tahan lama, jadi pilihan lain salah.

questions.prompt: Complete with the comparative form of the adjectives in brackets.
questions.text: Sunny Bay is ___ (safe) and ___ (peaceful) than Riverton, but Riverton is ___ (modern).
answers: safer
more peaceful
more modern
questions.explanation: Safe → safer (berakhiran e, tambah -r). Peaceful dan modern adalah adjective dua suku kata → more.

questions.prompt: Put the parts in the correct order.
questions.explanation: Pendapat (In my opinion) + subjek + superlative + in + tempat + alasan dengan because.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the correct option: Today is ___ day of the year. It's 38 degrees!
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Hot → gandakan t → the hottest. Membandingkan dengan semua hari dalam setahun → superlative.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Complete with the correct form of the adjectives in brackets.
unitTestQuestions.text: Trains are ___ (comfortable) than buses, but they aren't as ___ (cheap) as buses.
answers: more comfortable
cheap
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Comfortable → more comfortable (comparative). Di antara as ... as, adjective tetap bentuk dasar: as cheap as.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Match each adjective with its superlative form.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: good → the best, bad → the worst (tidak beraturan), busy → the busiest (y → -iest), famous → the most famous (adjective panjang).

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Find the mistake in the sentence.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Better sudah berarti lebih baik. Jangan tambahkan more.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Rewrite the sentence so that it has the same meaning.
unitTestQuestions.sentence: No other student in the class is as tall as Bima.
answers: Bima is the tallest student in the class.
Bima is the tallest student in his class.
Bima is the tallest in the class.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Tidak ada murid lain setinggi Bima → Bima adalah murid paling tinggi: the tallest student in the class.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the best word: My old car broke down every week, but this new one never has problems. It's very ___.

unitTestQuestions.text: The Grand Hotel was ___ hotel in the city, and the rooms were much ___ than ours.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Di antara semua hotel di kota → superlative: the most expensive. Membandingkan dua kamar (mereka vs kami) + than → comparative: bigger.
